name: @papercupai/repomix
description: Pack a project (or a subset of it) into a single LLM-friendly document. Wraps the official Repomix npm package and exposes `pack` as both an HTTP endpoint and an MCP tool. First-party tool for scoper/architect/operator/reviewer/debugger roles when they need a holistic view of the codebase; workers get one call per chunk.
author: Papercusp

tools.name: pack
tools.description: Pack a project (or subset) into a single LLM-friendly document. Returns inline content for small outputs (<50k chars); writes to .papercusp/scratch/ and returns a path reference for larger outputs.

include.description: Glob patterns to include. Default: everything not in .gitignore.

ignore.description: Glob patterns to ignore (in addition to .gitignore).

format.description: Output format. XML is preferred for Claude; markdown for general LLMs; plain for raw concat.

compress.description: Strip imports/whitespace, keep signatures only. Useful for very large repos.

guidance.when: You need to feed a project (or subset) into the LLM as one document — code reviews, refactor planning, "summarize this repo".
guidance.notWhen: For a git DIFF specifically, use `code2prompt.diff`. For a single URL's content, use `fetch_plus.fetch_clean`.

defaultIgnore.description: Patterns ignored by default unless overridden by the per-call `ignore` argument.

inlineThresholdChars.description: Outputs smaller than this are returned inline; larger ones are written to .papercusp/scratch/ and returned as a path reference.
